blocks.x: Cyber & Zero-Trust for Care Management & Population Health — zero-trust by architecture, not by slide — identity, detection, resilience and ai security in one program applied to the care management & population health operating unit of Healthcare & Life Sciences.

Care management succeeds on precision targeting and timely intervention: identifying rising-risk members, coordinating across providers, and proving quality outcomes. It is a data-discipline business — and the data discipline is usually the missing part.

items: Care teams share sensitive data across vendors; controls lag.
Claims, clinical, SDOH and engagement data siloed; risk stratification runs on claims only.

blocks.x: The pattern composes Cyber Resilience & Incident Recovery, Identity & Access Modernization, Cyber Resilience & Incident Recovery from the Cybersecurity & Zero-Trust tower, wired into the unit's workflows (Risk stratification, Care outreach and scheduling, Program matching) on Achala Sentinel and Achala Compass. Governance inherits the sector frame — HIPAA among others — with evidence generated by the delivery itself.

items: Secure at the control plane — posture, workload and data security engineered into the platform.
Secure the models themselves — prompt-injection defense, agent containment and AI red-teaming.
Assume breach, plan recovery — resilience engineered, rehearsed and measured.
vendor access governed with monitoring (coordination secure)
